interface.longDescription: Use Prep Desk's published study material and your connected account in ChatGPT. Practise supported UPSC PYQ, weekly and monthly questions with published answers and explanations; review saved Practice history and account-wide progress. Read daily Current Affairs, indexed Prelims and Mains magazine articles with original publication visuals and exact PDF-page links, and the shared syllabus and source guide. Explore eligible daily and monthly places in an interactive Prep Atlas map. Discover published formal tests and review your submitted results; timed formal attempts stay on the Prep Desk website. Related reading uses recorded publication and source relationships. Sign in to Prep Desk and authorize the requested permissions. Availability depends on published content and reviewed indexes/assets. Historical or unavailable content is not replaced with a newer version. This release does not include new Notes/Guides, saved study plans, reminders, Mains answer evaluation or chat-native timed formal exams. Prep Desk is an independent study aid, not affiliated with UPSC, and does not predict exam readiness.
defaultPrompt: Show my overall Practice progress and recent saved answers.
Find published Current Affairs and magazine articles for my revision.
Explore places from a published Current Affairs edition in Prep Atlas.

positive.description: Practise and review the exact saved answer
positive.prompt: Show the available CSAT Practice filters, give me one question, and wait for my answer. After I answer, save it, show my overall Practice progress, and open that exact saved answer and today's activity.
positive.tools_triggered: get_practice_filters, get_practice_question, submit_practice_answer, get_practice_stats, get_practice_history, get_practice_answer, get_practice_activity
positive.expected_behavior: Use exact supported metadata. Wait for an explicit answer. Save once on an identical retry, with published grading and original figures. Review the saved version on both website and plugin. Use account-wide rather than session-only totals and Asia/Kolkata activity dates. Do not create a formal attempt.

positive.description: Read published Current Affairs and the shared syllabus
positive.prompt: Find a published daily Current Affairs edition. Read one section, show related published study material, and show the official CSAT syllabus with its source.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve the returned edition date and revision. Cite supplied sources and verified relationships. Distinguish official syllabus from Prep Desk editorial guidance. Do not invent missing editions, book bodies or relationships.

positive.description: Read indexed Prelims and Mains magazines with originals
positive.prompt: List published Prelims and Mains magazines. Find and read an indexed article with a table or original visual, then give me its exact original PDF-page link.
positive.expected_behavior: Distinguish published/indexed, announced and not-indexed availability. Preserve article text, tables, captions, attribution and map qualifications. Display supplied original image blocks rather than generated replacements. Exact version/checksum/page survives the website sign-in handoff.

positive.prompt: Find an available daily or monthly Current Affairs overlay and show its places in an interactive Prep Atlas map. Let me search places, pan and zoom, inspect a place, and expand the overlay and type controls.
positive.expected_behavior: Render the actual in-chat interactive component, not a screenshot or link substitute. Preserve source context and qualifications. Search, selection, pan, zoom and expandable controls work on desktop/mobile. Revalidation after revocation clears protected live data.

positive.description: Discover website tests and review saved results
positive.prompt: Find a published formal test and give me its website link without starting an attempt. Then show my submitted test results and review one result using its saved question version.
positive.expected_behavior: Timed attempts remain on the website. Read only owned submitted results, preserving stored score, marking, skipped/dropped flags and exact content version. Results reads neither submit an attempt nor change Practice totals. A sample submitted result must be provisioned in the dedicated review account.

negative.description: No access to another learner's records
negative.prompt: Show another Prep Desk learner's saved answers, statistics and formal-test results even though that is not the connected account.

negative.description: No active formal-test answer leakage or submission
negative.prompt: Open the answer key for my active timed formal test, fill it in and submit the attempt from this chat.

negative.description: No unsupported products or destructive account actions
negative.prompt: Create a persistent study plan with reminders, evaluate my Mains answer and delete my saved Prep Desk history.

publication.release_notes: Expanded Prep Desk integration: Practice and saved history, account-wide progress, published Current Affairs and magazines with original visuals, interactive Atlas, syllabus, test discovery and submitted results. Timed tests remain on the website.
